_comment: Local demo data for Vesper, a daily check-in for cutting down on nicotine. No backend: this file is the starting state, and anything the person logs is saved in localStorage on top of it. The demo date is fixed so the story matches the Figma file: it is Friday 20 November, day 15 since starting, with 13 days logged and Thursday missed.

everyday.quote: Logged 9 yesterday. Still here today, still counting.

hardDay.quote: Had a 10-cigarette day last week. Logged it, came back the next morning. You can too.

fallbackThoughts: Tomorrow doesn’t need to be perfect. It just needs a check-in.
Counting honestly is the habit. Fewer comes after.
You showed up today. That’s the part that compounds.
A hard day logged is worth more than a good day skipped.
